correctness.rationale: Two exact mod-four decompositions separate coefficient supports into residue classes, ruling out four consecutive exponents. The I and J overlap recurrences follow by parity splitting with E0 empty. Stern summation proves U_k=(3^k-1)/2 and the first-moment count, giving pair/triple totals and exact run counts. Finite independent Lucas-parity verification confirms supports through n=4096 and all dyadic-prefix counts r=2..12; finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural local statistic of the classic 0/1 Stern-polynomial support is classified for every polynomial (sharp forbidden consecutive run length) and every dyadic scale (all exact multiplicities). Higher-order adjacent/triple correlations are not merely renamings of the classical Stern row-sum product. The resulting limiting run proportions are nontrivial and fully proved.
